messages:
Maya (Marketing): Hey runtime team — quick ask for post-launch bench artifacts. We want a clean set of numbers for the blog + webinar: cold-start heatmap, 99p tail, and quantized vs fp16 deltas. No crazy deadlines but would love a tentative ETA.

Eli (Eng Runtime): Thanks Maya. Can you list the exact measurements and the model variants you want? Also do you need raw logs or summarized charts?

Maya (Marketing): Short list: 1) Cold-start heatmap (latency by request index + warmup iterations) 2) 99/95/50p latency breakdown per seq len 3) Token-cost delta q4_0 vs fp16 4) Embedding throughput for small/large batches 5) Sample payloads + minimal reproducible command. Prefer both raw logs (for audit) and a 1-slide summary. Model: gpt-open-13b and quantized variant q4_0. Dataset: ~500 samples (mix of short 32‑token and long 2048 token).

Sam (Eng Runtime): Got it. We'll do: smoke run (sanity), then 3 replicates for each config. Need the exact sample list + the seed for deterministic prompts. Also confirm concurrency target (we test at 1, 4, 16).

Maya (Marketing): Concurrency 1 and 8 as our target for marketing graphs. Seed: 42. I'll drop a GDrive link with sample payloads in a sec.

Nora (Data Science): Please add quality sanity checks — model delta on a small eval set (top-1 agreement) and basic log-probs. We need to ensure quantized variant doesn't regress on the canonical prompts.

Olivia (Product): Add per-route breakdown (generation vs embedding) and cost-per-token estimates. For the webinar we want a single chart comparing warm vs cold for the quantized profile.

Eli (Eng Runtime): Plan: bench bot will run smoke for both fp16 and q4_0, warmup=1000 tokens, sequence lengths [32,512,2048], repeats=3. We'll capture: p50/p95/p99, cold-start heatmap (first 200 requests), KV cache hit ratios, token cost estimates. Example command we will run:

```
./bench_runner --model gpt-open-13b --variant q4_0 --samples samples.json --concurrency 1,8 --seq-lens 32,512,2048 --warmup 1000 --repeats 3 --output /tmp/bench_run.json
```

Sam (Eng Runtime): We'll also instrument per-token emission latency and token-cost accounting. Benchnode will generate charts.

benchbot: Job queued: bench-2399990001-42 (smoke). ETA ~ 2 hours for smoke, full sweep overnight.

Eli (Eng Runtime): Quick note — for the cold-start heatmap we take the first 200 unique requests post-deploy; we'll produce both raw CSV and a heatmap PNG. Also adding KV-cache-hit=on/off toggles for comparison.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Could we get a provisional 1-slide PNG by tomorrow EOD for the comms team? If smoke looks clean, we'll signal go for the blog.

Eli (Eng Runtime): Yes — if smoke passes we'll push a draft slide by tomorrow EOD. Full artifacts and raw logs by 48 hours.

Nora (Data Science): I'll run the top-1 agreement check once logs are in. If there's >1% regression we'll flag and ask for targeted reruns.

Maya (Marketing): Awesome, thanks all. I'll post the sample payload link in this thread and mark embargo until numbers are reviewed. :thumbsup:

benchbot: bench-2399990001-42 started (smoke). Logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bench-2399990001-42

Sam (Eng Runtime): Noted. Adding KV cache toggles to the run matrix now.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — appreciate the fast turn.
